newsitem.title: KENYA: Police storm Kenya polytechnic, fire over students.
newsitem.headline: Police storm Kenya polytechnic, fire over students.

text.p: Hundreds of police stormed the Kenya Polytechnic campus in Nairobi on Monday, firing bullets over the heads of stone-throwing students, witnesses said.
They said police fired over the heads of students on the edge of the Kenya Polytechnic campus on Haile Selassie Avenue while hundreds of officers stormed the centre of Monday's unrest.

Thousands of students took to the streets more than an hour earlier, stoning cars and blocking the street with makeshift barricades and burning tyres. They demanded constitutional reforms before presidential and parliamentary polls this year.
